interventions.description: Consolidate and narrow the wide curb cuts to the commercial parking lots, using raised curbs to clearly define the pedestrian walkway.

interventions.title: Mid-Block Crossing with Refuge
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crossing signs or Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFBs) to alert drivers to the crossing.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Infill
interventions.description: Construct a continuous sidewalk on the near side of the street to provide a safe, separated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Driveway Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the driveway entrance and use tighter corner radii to slow down vehicles entering and exiting the parking lot.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer Enhancement
interventions.description: Increase the density of street trees to provide a better physical and psychological buffer from high-speed traffic.

interventions.title: Install Continuous Sidewalk
interventions.description: Construct a standard-width concrete sidewalk to provide a safe, dedicated space for pedestrian movement separated from the roadway.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer Strip
interventions.description: Add a landscaped buffer between the new sidewalk and the roadway to provide physical separation and improve the pedestrian experience.
